ground_truth.label: negative
ground_truth.rationale: CLEAR BENIGN (unambiguous eligibility-screen case, c3-rater-materials §9). The FIRST create of a contact succeeds (201 {status:1,msg:"Create contacts success"}). A SECOND, identical create (same accountId+documentNumber) returns HTTP 201 with body {status:0,msg:"Contacts already exists"} and by design persists nothing new; the read-back shows exactly ONE contact (no duplicate). The write was correctly REJECTED (the body says status:0), not silently lost -- intended duplicate-rejection business behaviour. A microservice-literate rater applying the rubric must label this benign (the body explicitly signals non-acceptance).
